title: CE5 night in Sedona with Greer's team and Demi Lovato: orbs, gold disc craft and an unseen blow
summary: Michael Herrera tells of CE5 night in Sedona with Greer's team and Demi Lovato: orbs, gold disc craft and an unseen blow, about unspecified (recent years) at Sedona, Arizona (off-grid site off a trail), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Sedona, Arizona (off-grid site off a trail)

tellings.quote: So, we're sitting there, we're seeing orbs, we're seeing, you know, discshaped craft appear in and out.

plain: A man named Michael Herrera told podcast host Jesse Michels about a night at a remote site off a trail near Sedona, Arizona. He says he was there with the team of Steven Greer, a man who leads group sessions meant to invite contact with visitors from elsewhere (a practice called CE5), along with the singer Demi Lovato and a woman named Paula Harris. Herrera says they sat and watched glowing balls of light and gold disc-shaped craft appear and vanish, and that someone took a blow from something nobody could see, which, if true, would mean such contact can be called up on purpose.
